items.title: Universal command palette (Ctrl+K / ⌘K) — any page to any page in two keystrokes
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the site has 130 sitemap pages across 60+ sections, a standalone /search/ page, and ZERO keyboard access to it — no keydown handler in the shell, no palette. Elite sites of this scale (Linear, Stripe, Vercel) treat the palette as the navigation spine. Outcome: any visitor (or member) reaches games/join/status/proof in 2 keystrokes; mobile gets the same index via the search icon. This is the single highest-leverage premium-feel + navigation item available.
items.recipe: L2 default: build assets/command-palette.js lazy-loaded on first Ctrl+K/⌘K or search-icon tap; index = sitemap.xml routes + page titles baked at build time into api/site-index.json by a new build step (fits existing generator+gate pattern — wire into build:check per feedback_new_asset_contract_gotchas: RUNTIME_TARGET classes not cssText, sitewide ambient block via propagate-nav.mjs, shell-hash awareness). Fuzzy match client-side, no external deps (CANON-039). Sections grouped by vault vocabulary (GAMES · VAULT · INTELLIGENCE · STUDIO). Respect nonce CSP — no inline handlers.

L1.recipe: Palette overlay wired to existing /search index, desktop Ctrl+K only, static route list from sitemap.xml.

L2.recipe: Full build-generated api/site-index.json (titles+descriptions), fuzzy match, recent-pages memory (localStorage), mobile entry via nav search icon, theme-safe styling in all themes.

L3.recipe: L2 + action verbs ("join", "verify us", "status"), member-aware entries when signed in (rank page, portal), and IGNIS-fed "live now" section from public api feeds.

items.title: Re-baseline Core Web Vitals truth post-RUM-restore, then kill the homepage CLS regression
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: data/rum-summary.json shows 7 total samples in 7 days (RUM ingest was 405 for a month until S300 restored it) and homepage CLS p75 = 0.1842 against a 0.1 budget — a FAILING CWV on the front door, low-sample but matching the known post-paint-widget-injection class. Geo LCP is elite (992ms p75 US, 464 samples) so CLS is the one red vital. Outcome: measured CWV pass-rate becomes trustworthy again and the homepage stops shifting under the visitor's first paint — direct conversion-path quality on the page every funnel starts from.
items.recipe: First verify beacon coverage: confirm every shell page carries the RUM beacon and the SW path uses raw fetch (feedback_sw_rum_beacon_raw_fetch); check sample counts rise daily for 2-3 days via data/rum-history.ndjson. In parallel reproduce homepage CLS with the existing bisect harness (feedback_cls_postpaint_injection_bisect): suspect late-injected widgets (status/pulse strips); reserve space with aspect-ratio/min-height or move injection pre-paint. Gate: rum-summary sufficientRoutes > 0 and homepage cwvPass true once samples ≥50.

L1.recipe: Beacon-coverage check + reserve-space CSS fix for the known injected homepage widgets.

L2.recipe: L1 + bisect-harness confirmation, INP hover-pollution guard re-check, and a build:check contract asserting reserved dimensions on injected blocks.

L3.recipe: L2 + per-route CWV badge on /status fed by rum-summary once sufficient, closing the loop publicly (Observability Honesty, CANON-031).

items.title: /proof — in-browser public verifier that lets any visitor re-verify the studio live
items.why: Carry from Wave D, now ranked: the repo's most under-exploited asset is its evidence apparatus — hash-chained deploy ledger, release proof, identity receipt, evidence graph, staging attestations — all already public JSON under /api/. No studio site on the internet lets a visitor click "Verify" and watch their own browser re-fetch the ledger, re-hash the chain, and compare digests. Outcome: trust → join conversion; also the strongest possible AI-agent signal (agents can verify claims mechanically). Innovation 8: not derivable from any template.
items.recipe: Build /proof/ page: client-side JS re-fetches api/staging-deploy-continuity.json + served NDJSON ledger, recomputes the content-addressed chain with WebCrypto SHA-256, verifies head/depth/predecessor links, and renders green/red per check with plain-language explanations (audience voice — no dev jargon, feedback_ai_content_audience_voice). Same pattern for release-proof hold reasons (honest: shows the current hold and why that is a feature). Link from footer + /status + agents.json. All client-side, zero new endpoints, CSP-safe.

L1.recipe: Static /proof page listing live proof feeds with one-click raw links and explanations; no client-side recompute yet.

L2.recipe: L1 + WebCrypto chain re-verification in the visitor's browser with per-check pass/fail UI.

L3.recipe: L2 + shareable verification permalink (?verified=<head>) and an agents.json capability entry advertising machine verification steps.

items.title: CANON-047 theme pass: AI image-test every theme, elevate light mode to first-class
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: a theme toggle exists and [data-theme="light"] appears in style.css, but SOUL demands light mode be a first-class experience and CANON-047 requires AI image-testing every theme (screenshot pages/panels/modals; no sub-WCAG-AA pairs) as a blocking release check. That verification pass has no recent evidence. Outcome (info-finding): a screenshot-verified readability matrix across themes × key pages; any visitor on light mode gets the same premium atmosphere instead of a thinned-out dark-theme inversion.
items.recipe: Playwright screenshot sweep (existing harness; snapshotDir explicit per feedback_playwright_snapshotdir_explicit, waitUntil load per polling pages) across home/games/membership/status/login in each theme; AI-review each image for contrast + atmosphere; fix flagged selectors respecting the body-prefix specificity contract (feedback_theme_selector_specificity). Record the matrix in docs/ and wire into /app-release-gate.

L1.recipe: Screenshot sweep + manual review of the 5 key pages in dark and light; fix any contrast failures found.

L2.recipe: L1 + modals/drawers/panels states, documented matrix, release-gate wiring.

L3.recipe: L2 + a third signature theme (e.g. 'Vault Ember' from the brand kit) shipped only if it passes the same gate.

items.title: Living Constellation hero — the portfolio as a real-data star map
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: api/constellation-activity.json, ecosystem-state.json and ecosystem-velocity.json already publish live public-safe ecosystem data that nothing renders atmospherically. A canvas star map on the homepage — each project a star (SPARKED bright, FORGE forging, sealed vaults as sigil-only dark stars per the sealed-vault pattern), real activity as pulses — is a signature visual moment no template site has, built entirely from data the site already ships. Outcome: homepage → games/portfolio click-through (each star is a link); visitors feel a living studio, not a brochure.
items.recipe: Single dependency-free canvas module, lazy-loaded after LCP (must NOT regress item 2 — reserve the hero box height first), prefers-reduced-motion honored with a static render, DPR-aware, touch + keyboard accessible (stars are real anchor overlays, canvas is decorative). Data from the existing feeds at build + gentle client refresh. Sealed projects render as unnamed sigils only (feedback_sealed_vault_pattern).

L1.recipe: Static generated SVG constellation from ecosystem-state.json, linked stars, no animation.

L2.recipe: Canvas with slow drift + activity pulses, reduced-motion fallback to L1 SVG, mobile-tuned density.

L3.recipe: L2 + constellation deep-view on /universe (dir exists) with per-star lore panels fed by the projects catalog.

items.title: IGNIS live-pulse strip — surface real studio intelligence on the public homepage
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: api/ignis-conduit.json, ignis-platform-status.json, ignis-roi.json and studio-pulse are already deployed public-safe feeds, but the homepage shows none of it — IGNIS integration currently ends at dedicated subpages a visitor never finds. A restrained one-line pulse strip ("IGNIS tracking 36 projects · 8 SPARKED · last ship 2h ago") makes the intelligence plane visible where visitors actually land. Outcome: homepage → /ignis and /studio-pulse click-through; positions the studio as AI-native to both humans and crawling agents. Voice-gated: public copy uses audience voice, no internal enums (feedback_voice_leak_patrol).
items.recipe: Build-time generated strip (no client fetch on critical path) injected via the propagate-nav.mjs ambient-block pattern (feedback_sitewide_ambient_pattern — never per-page tags), reserved height (no CLS), click-through to /ignis. Derive every number from the deployed feeds, never hardcode (feedback_derive_dont_hardcode_public_surfaces); cross-surface coherence gate so the strip and /ignis never disagree (feedback_cross_surface_coherence_gate).

L1.recipe: Static build-time strip on homepage only, three derived facts, linked.

L2.recipe: L1 + sitewide ambient placement, coherence gate, gentle client-side refresh with reserved layout.

L3.recipe: L2 + per-page contextual intelligence (games pages show that game's live signals from its project feed).

items.title: Structured receipt on Obelisk link FAILURE — diagnosable first logins
items.why: Carry (genius list 92): today a failed identity link logs a code and redirects to ?auth_error=bridge_failed; the member sees a generic failure and the studio learns nothing — at exactly the moment the first real members arrive. Outcome: every first-login failure becomes diagnosable within minutes (privacy-safe: code + plane, zero identifiers), protecting the join → member conversion at its most fragile step.
items.recipe: Worker writes a privacy-safe failure receipt (code, plane, timestamp, no identifiers) to the existing KV/telemetry path; login page renders a specific, human recovery message per code family. Tests assert no identifier can enter the receipt (mutation-test the assertion per feedback_receipt_roundtrip_and_selftest_must_call_real_code).

L1.recipe: Map auth_error codes to specific user-facing recovery copy on /login.

L2.recipe: L1 + privacy-safe server-side failure receipt with identifier-free guarantee test.

L3.recipe: L2 + failure-rate signal in the identity receipt feed so a spike is visible on the ops side.

items.title: Stop /status publishing a false incident — CF bot-challenge detection in worker-route-provenance
items.why: Carry [S301→NEXT][OBS/P0], still open and PUBLISHING A FALSE INCIDENT NOW: api/worker-route-provenance.json reads state:mismatch, 0/5 routes, every observation 403 text/html — the signature of a Cloudflare interstitial, while direct probes return healthy 200/302. The history ledger converts the false reading into a false DURATION. Outcome (info-finding + trust): /status shows true state to visitors and agents; the availability history stops accruing fictional downtime. Ranked despite low innovation because a public trust surface is lying today.
items.recipe: Reuse the isChallenged({status, contentType}) primitive already self-tested in scripts/verify-obelisk-edge-deployment.mjs: 403/503 HTML where JSON/redirect was due → challenged → unverified, never mismatch (D-S300.1, feedback_cf_bot_challenge_not_outage). Then verify build-worker-route-history does not accrue incident duration from challenged observations, and regenerate the five consumer feeds in one cascade (feedback_skipci_publisher_must_cascade_derived_artifacts). Sequence whole-cascade in one session — a half-landed cascade is worse than the finding.

L1.recipe: Challenge detection in the builder + history-accrual guard + full consumer cascade regen.

L2.recipe: L1 + self-test matrix covering challenged/mismatch/ok per route type.

L3.recipe: L2 + a shared lib extraction so every prober in the repo classifies challenges identically (Ark pattern-share to studio-ops).

executionLog.note: L2+. Shared lib vantage-challenge.mjs; provenance state unverified-before-mismatch; history refuses unverified by state; /status renders neutral. Live probe 5/5 matched. Tests 9/9+44/44+19/19. Commit 6c228ad17.

items.title: Re-verify mobile parity contracts + tablet breakpoint sweep
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: CANON-041 parity was attested 2026-07-08 (S268) — ~35 sessions of shipped UI ago, including new login/identity surfaces. The attestation is stale as evidence even if the site is fine (recovery is verification, not restoration). Outcome (info-finding): current pass/fail across the seven structural mobile contracts on iPhone/Android/tablet widths; any regression on the join/login path caught before members hit it.
items.recipe: Run node scripts/check-mobile-contracts.mjs (17 detector self-tests + 7 contracts) + Playwright responsive sweep at 390/768/1024 widths on home, games, membership, login, vault-member. Fix any failures; refresh context/MOBILE_PARITY.md date with evidence.

L1.recipe: Contract run + attestation refresh; file fixes only if red.

L2.recipe: L1 + visual screenshot sweep on 3 widths × 2 themes with fixes.

L3.recipe: L2 + add a tablet-specific contract (768-1024 range currently untested by the seven).

items.title: Break the agents.json build cycle with a static proof-surface reference
items.why: Carry [S300][AGENT/P1]: agents.json → proof-surface → status-proof → ai-discovery-health → agents.json; no ordering converges (proven, reorder reverted). The site's primary AI-agent discovery surface cannot honestly update. Outcome: agents.json regenerates deterministically every build, keeping the AI-agent front door current (CANON-048 dual-audience).
items.recipe: Replace the mirrored live verdict inside agents.json with a static reference to the proof-surface URL (the agent fetches the verdict live from the feed instead of trusting a baked copy — which is also MORE honest). One-cascade regen + build:check.

L1.recipe: Static URL reference swap + cascade regen + gate green.

L2.recipe: L1 + agents.json capability entries for /proof verification and the command-palette site index.

L3.recipe: L2 + .ai/ companion pages for remaining top-level sections (games already have them).

items.title: Answer-engine depth: FAQ/HowTo/speakable schema + sitewide breadcrumb coverage
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: JSON-LD exists (3 blocks on homepage; BreadcrumbList on games/journal indexes) but coverage is partial — /faq has rich Q&A content with no FAQPage schema audit evidence, no speakable markup for answer engines, and breadcrumb coverage beyond games/journal is unverified. GEO/AEO is where AI-first discovery happens (CANON-048). Outcome (info-finding + SEO): AI answer engines and rich results can cite membership/games/faq answers directly; measurable via Search Console rich-result reports.
items.recipe: Generator-owned (feedback_generator_owns_full_head_contract): extend the page generators to emit FAQPage on /faq, BreadcrumbList sitewide, speakable on journal posts + faq; add a build:check contract counting schema types per page class so coverage can never silently regress. Verify with Google Rich Results test on 3 representative pages.

L1.recipe: FAQPage + sitewide BreadcrumbList via generators + coverage gate.

L2.recipe: L1 + speakable, VideoGame schema on game pages, Organization sameAs completion.

L3.recipe: L2 + llms.txt per-section deep links and freshness stamp wired to the build.

items.title: context-meter.mjs measures a heuristic, claims a session — make it honest or rename it
items.why: Carry (genius #1, 96): it reported 1.5%-used · CONTINUE while the live session was near exhaustion, because it measures fresh-session bootstrap cost, not the session it gauges. Same class as verifying a declaration instead of the condition. Outcome (info-finding): the start/closeout gate stops issuing false greens that can walk a session off a cliff mid-implementation.
items.recipe: Either read a real signal (transcript size when the harness exposes it) or rename output to 'bootstrap-cost estimate' with verdict semantics that never claim session state; update the two consumers (start gate, brief renderer). Honest-dark default when unmeasurable (feedback_honest_dark_status_publishing).

L1.recipe: Rename + honest verdict semantics + consumer updates.

L2.recipe: L1 + attempt real measurement from available session artifacts with unverified fallback.

L3.recipe: L2 + Ark pattern-share since every studio repo runs the same meter.

items.title: Post-push CI confirmation — closeout verifies the remote run, not the exit code
items.why: Carry (genius 96): landed ≠ verified — [skip ci] anywhere in a commit body skips ALL workflows, and a push whose CI never ran reads as green locally (feedback_skip_ci_token_in_commit_body_skips_everything, feedback_closeout_push_verification). Outcome (info-finding): every closeout ends with a confirmed remote CI verdict or an honest 'unverified' — no silent skips.
items.recipe: Closeout step: gh run list --commit <sha> after push; assert a workflow actually started and record conclusion (or honest pending) into the handoff. Guard against the [skip ci]-tip stranding CF Pages (add deploy-trigger commit when needed).

L1.recipe: gh-run assertion in closeout with honest-pending recording.

L2.recipe: L1 + CF Pages deploy-tip check (check-deploy-tip pattern).

L3.recipe: L2 + failure triage note auto-drafted into next session's board (new-regression vs pre-existing debt split).

items.title: Close the edge + GitHub Pages second origin for internal paths
items.why: Carry [S300→NEXT][AGENT/P1]: origin pruning works (CF Pages 404s /logs/, /context/, /scripts/) but the APEX still serves them 200 via stale URL-keyed edge copies + GitHub Pages publishing the branch verbatim as a second, unpruned origin. Internal docs remain publicly fetchable. Outcome: internal operational surface is not served to the public or to crawlers; verified by live 404 probes at the apex. GH-Pages disable/re-point is founder-scoped (it is the documented warm rollback origin, D-S289.8) — agent half is the targeted purge + verification.
items.recipe: Targeted purge-by-URL for the identified stale URLs with post-purge eviction VERIFICATION (never trust the API success flag); document the GH-Pages decision (pruned publish branch vs disable) as a founder escalation with both options costed.

L1.recipe: Targeted purge + verified eviction for known internal paths; probe matrix committed.

L2.recipe: L1 + recurring probe in the uptime cron so regression is an alarm, not a discovery.

L3.recipe: L2 + pruned publish-branch implementation once founder decides the rollback-origin question.

items.title: public.obelisk_identity_link — kill the login scan cliff (founder-gated design, approved direction)
items.why: Carry [S301→NEXT][SEC/P1] with the corrected design already recorded (D-S301.10): per-login admin scans hit a hard cliff at ~2,000 accounts where EVERY login fails closed; live headroom 1,748. The link table (obelisk_sub PK, user_id unique, inserted before the metadata write) supplies the uniqueness auth denies us and an indexed lookup, killing both full table walks. Outcome: login capacity ceases to be a scaling cliff before real member growth reaches it. Auth-flow change → founder escalation is part of the item, not a reason to skip ranking it.
items.recipe: Escalate with the recorded design for sign-off, then: migration via management API (pre-image captured), worker rewiring with fallback to the existing scan, self-healing orphan-row semantics tested, live verification through verify-supabase-runtime.mjs so evidence is machine-produced.

L1.recipe: Founder escalation doc with design, rollback, and blast radius — unblocks the rest.

L2.recipe: Full implementation post-approval: table + worker rewiring + fallback + machine-produced evidence.

L3.recipe: L2 + daily check-obelisk-link-readiness cron once SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN lands as an Actions secret (separate founder precondition).

skipped.reason: Premise re-verified as still valid (3 membership pages, /leaderboards vs /vault-wall duplication) but the surfaces are SENSITIVE-classified — they cannot ride the content lane and are sequenced AFTER promotion by explicit board decision. Ranking it now would invite a half-landed auth-adjacent change.
External: blocked on Obelisk shipping /auth/revoke (D-S302.5); our half is shipped. Plus one founder sign-in to prove client registration. Not agent-schedulable.
False premise for further work: geo-vitals shows LCP p75 992ms US at high confidence (464 samples) — well inside the 1.8s bar. Spending here would be waste; CLS is the real red vital (item 2).

Navigation depth is real but the command palette (item 1) addresses it at higher leverage without touching the attested mobile drawer contracts; a nav rebuild would re-open seven structural mobile contracts for marginal gain.
